{{Quote|But who really am I? I am Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam, self-proclaimed Explorer Extraordinaire.|Tinrilo x'Rilsam's log|<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />}}
'''Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam''' was an individual who served in the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] and later became an [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] when he retired during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I was not always an explorer. I've recently retired from the Royal Security Forces on Naboo, having served in many battles, wars and gruesome memories I'd like to forget. I'm old in age and in spirit, although more so the latter; I've lived my life and I've seen great things. I've seen my children thrive, peace achieved. I'm an old veteran of life. Finally, I can turn my eye to my passion and dedicate the rest of my existence to it. History... those fine threads of the past we often severe, delicate tunnels to the fading memories just beyond our reach.|Tinrilo x'Rilsam's log|<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />}}
Tinrilo x'Rilsam spent most of his life on the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="SWG:AEL2" /> where he lived with his family, including his children. He joined the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Security Forces]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and had a long and distinguished career. He finally retired sometime after the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:AEL1" />

During his childhood, Tinrilo x'Rilsam used to visit [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He developed his taste for adventure on the desert planet while playing for hours in [[Mosor]]'s [[Mosor's Maze|Maze]]. Upon he retired from the RNSF, x'Rilsam decided to dedicate the rest of his life to his passion: history. The former RSF officer became an explorer and wandered the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:AEL1" /> One of his friend from Naboo, [[Pisk]], also became an explorer and both planed to meet up at the [[Cheapside Cantina|cantina]] in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] after their explorations had been drawn to a close.<ref name="SWG:AEL2" /> Self-proclaimed Explorer Extraordinaire, Tinrilo x'Rilsam explored many worlds in the galaxy, such as [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="SWG:AEL1" /> Naboo, [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Rori/Legends|Rori]],<ref name="SWG:AEL2" /> and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].<ref name="SWG:AEL7">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Explorer's Log (7/8)}}</ref> Some of his discoveries included the [[Spy's Haven]] and [[Hero's Grave]] on Tatooine,<ref name="SWG:AEL1" /> the [[Altar of Evil]] and an [[Imperial outpost (Naboo)|Imperial outpost]] on Naboo,<ref name="SWG:AEL2" /> an abandoned [[Imperial survey camp]], a [[Solitary Hutt|Korga hutt]] and the crash site of [[Vendi Kjleno]]'s ''[[Jade Starunner]]'' on Endor.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />

Tinrilo "Adventi" x'Rilsam later wrote the story of his explorations in logs that were released after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:AEL1" /><ref name="SWG:AEL2" /><ref name="SWG:AEL7" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tinrilo x'Rilsam was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AEL1" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tinrilo x'Rilsam was added to the game with its first expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'', released on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. His backstory appeared in three [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage units]] that players could [[W:c:swg:Loot|loot]] during space battles.<ref name="SWG:AEL1" /><ref name="SWG:AEL2" /><ref name="SWG:AEL7" />
